peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 11.4% below its local comparables; 15 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (40.3): 4.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 43 of 108 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 87.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,188,888 ($1,299 psf, 882–914 sq ft; 7 resales, Aug 2025–Jul 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,483 psf (range $1,133–1,702); 12.4% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $168,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $1,750,000 ($1,322 psf, 1,259–1,410 sq ft; 17 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,476 psf (range $1,233–1,548); 10.4% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $204,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Pasir Ris MRT about 710 m, Tampines MRT about 1,860 m; closer than 44 of 116 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest Elias Park Primary School about 340 m; more than 75 of 116 similar developments (the same as 10). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 660 m), more than 27 of 116 similar developments (the same as 26); nearest hawker centre Tampines North Hawker Centre about 840 m; nearest park Pasir Ris Park about 600 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Parktown Residence, 73 new sales, about 840 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 30 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 718 new sales and 448 resales (1,166 purchases); new sales were 61.6% of these purchases. Subsales (25) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 448 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 65 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 448 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 427 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (+4.9%). Planning-area private resales −4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
